Box2D 2.2.0 by Erin Catto and contributors. This is the active physics source.

The supplied libBeansQuest.so contains b2_version = {2,2,0},
CollisionWorld::WorldToPhysicsScale = 1/64 and PhysicsToWorldScale = 64.
Its CollisionWorld::Update calls Step(dt,10,10), then ClearForces().

Official archived release:
https://storage.googleapis.com/google-code-archive-downloads/v2/code.google.com/box2d/Box2D_v2.2.0.zip
Archive SHA256:
1b298d30d8eb562fbe2a16cf16a6ec0ffc85688b13d4c0a490850c0eac6b9f31

The original zlib license is preserved in License.txt and source headers.
Local changes are explicitly marked and recorded in PORTING.diff:
- Win32 heap allocation instead of malloc/free.
- CRT-free x87 math helpers and finite-value check.
- Local pair sorting with the original comparison order.
- Local exponential helper for rope damping.
- MSVC _WIN32 detection in both timer source and header.

SOURCE.json pins every upstream/local source hash. Verify with:
python tools/audit_box2d.py

Matching the library version does not establish bitwise simulation parity.
The game-level callbacks, fixture filters and event ordering require separate
review against the native library. The previous 2.3.1 tree is retained only as
historical source and is not part of the build.
